title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer regional failover ordering and load-shedding thrashing
author: Asha Patel
description: Urgent hotfix to the SLO enforcer and regional failover logic: during a multi-region degradation we observed failover thrashing and load-shedding storms caused by non-deterministic ordering and immediate backoff propagation. This PR introduces deterministic region ordering for failover decisions, a smoothing window on backoff thresholds (token-bucket smoothing), and a guard that prefers local-region capacity when the local SLO is marginally degraded to avoid unnecessary cross-region routing. Motivation: outages observed during large fleet-scale traffic spikes (INC-9521) where several regions simultaneously tripped the circuit breaker, then immediately re-routed back and forth causing cascading load-shedding and customer-facing 5xxs. Changes in this PR: 1) enforce deterministic comparator in SLO enforcer (region priority + stable tiebreaker), 2) add smoothing window to backoff state transitions to prevent sub-second oscillation, 3) add an early-exit when local capacity is available within a 10% threshold to reduce cross-region failovers, 4) revert a recent aggressive default on circuit-breaker cooldown that caused too-fast retries, 5) add unit and integration tests and a canary job in perf-canary to validate behaviour. Checklist: - [x] reproducer and incident notes attached (INC-9521) - [x] unit tests added for ordering and smoothing - [x] integration test with simulated multi-region spike - [x] added metrics (enforcer.failover_decision_reason, enforcer.backoff_smooth_count) - [x] performance canary job configured - [x] docs note in release_notes. This description aggregates design rationale, implementation notes, and testing details in a single narrative string.
commits: Fix: deterministic region comparator and stable tiebreaker for SLO enforcer
Fix: token-bucket smoothing for backoff transitions; add smoothing window config
Revert: aggressive circuit-breaker cooldown default introduced in PR-386901
Test: unit tests for ordering, integration harness for regional spike
Docs: release notes and metrics docs
review_comments: Connor Li: The deterministic ordering change looks good; can you add a comment explaining the tiebreaker choice (region id stable hash) so future readers understand why?
Asha Patel: Added comment and test verifying stable tiebreaker. See orderer_test.go (stable hash seeded from region UUID).
Miguel Torres: Backoff smoothing config seems reasonable; we should default to conservative smoothing in prod. Also please ensure metrics expose smoothing_rate for alerting.
Asha Patel: Exposed enforcer.backoff_smooth_count and smoothing_rate; added to metrics_registry and docs. Default set to conservative values (500ms window, burst allowance 2).
Priya Singh: Can we add a small canary in perf-canary to simulate the multi-region spike before merging? We should validate no regression to latency SLOs.
Asha Patel: Added perf-canary job slo-enforcer-canary.yml which runs a 10m multi-region spike and collects failover events/latency; ran canary internally with green results. CI artifacts attached.
release_notes: Hotfix: Stabilize SLO enforcer regional failover ordering and add smoothing to backoff to prevent thrashing; conservative cooldown defaults restored. Adds new metrics for monitoring. See docs/release_notes/2026-02-21-slo-enforcer.md for details.

notes: This hotfix addresses INC-9521 and was cherry-picked to release/2026-02 for customers on older stable builds. Monitored for 72 hours with no regressions reported.
